stygar_trait: Mastitis detection (Lely on line California mastitis test, 43) and Health disorder e.g. mastitis or pneumonia (HerdInsights, 30), Table 2 page 7, both commercial farm
evidence_note: Stygar Table 2 page 7 lists Lely on line CMT (43) under Mastitis detection and HerdInsight (30) under Health disorder, both validated on commercial farms; Table 1 page 6 places 43 and 30 in the independent column. Appendix aims: FirstLook Mastitis system names mastitis identification; ten aims name udder health. Maroto Molina do not discuss clinical mastitis incidence (I006).
notes: Candidates: validated_commercial, because Stygar validate detection of mastitis cases on commercial farms; none, because the EFSA ABM is the incidence rate of clinical cases from veterinary or farm records, not detection. Listed in notes/unsure.md. Hardware class given for the cheapest commercial candidate, inline milk sensing in the milking system.
